title: Sherpa-UI component example
description: One realistic instance of a component, shipped beside its spec as sherpa-<name>.example.json: its markup, the data each part is populated with, and the part to open. The a11y gate, the MCP's get_component, a gallery and the reference read it.

html.description: The markup, as a page writes it. An array is joined with no separator.

fill.description: Data for populate(), in order: the first element matching `at` takes `data`.

use.description: When to reach for it, and what to use instead. One or two sentences; a sherpa-* it names must exist. The reference and get_component show it.

show.description: A part to open with show(), for one that draws only when open.
